summary: The packet builder, the packet verifier and the decision gate now derive CI-evidence completeness and the trust basis themselves, from the GitHub data inside the evidence and the baseline's own workflow and policy, instead of reading evidence_complete, ci_passed and the trust basis from the document. A forged verdict cannot hide missing check-run or job-log validation, a document that contradicts its own data is refused, and earlier-shaped (legacy) evidence parses but is flagged and cannot qualify. Task ids accept one optional capital letter (OPS-0005B) with the matching lower-case branch letter, defined once in ops/lib/ids.mjs and carried by four schemas and four readers, with a consistency test. A baseline that is the reviewed head, descends from it, or already contains reviewed content is refused unless an exception names an existing decision, and the manifest and the gate say whether a baseline is independent. The pre-implementation baseline is cc0476484c002c41c3f6cc24310810655f887cf8: a commit that contains only the schema-valid task definition. Nothing was pushed, merged or deployed. HUMAN_DECISIONS.md, the OPS-0005B records and every forbidden path are unchanged.

risk.rationale: The work changes the review control plane (the packet builder, verifier and decision gate), four schemas and the tests that guard them, so policy computes class B and every changed path is protected. It adds no write capability, no workflow, no secret, no dependency and no website file; it only makes the consumers stricter.

unresolved_issues.description: An evidence file is still an unauthenticated document. The consumers derive what they can from the GitHub data inside it, but cannot recompute the three log-structure checks (they are required as recorded and named). A forger who invents a self-consistent document with fabricated GitHub data passes every offline check; only fetching the data from GitHub and rebuilding the packet to compare its hash closes this (OQ-0035).
Nothing on this branch or on the OPS-0005B branch has run on GitHub Actions or been reviewed by an independent session. The clean-environment results are local simulations.

The baseline's relation to the work is computed by the builder from git; a verifier without the repository can check that the claims agree with each other and with the evidence but cannot repeat the computation. The gate cannot judge whether an exception is justified, only that the named decision exists.
The derivation takes its expectations from the baseline's workflow. Evidence collected against another workflow (CI changed between the base and the baseline) fails closed and a person looks.

The original OPS-0003 packet's gate result changes from the earlier outcome to requires-corrections because its evidence is of the earlier shape; the original OPS-0005 reviewer decision stays advisory (human approval required, never binding, automation all false).
A mode-only change (100644 to 100755) to creative/motion-ad/scripts/deliver-v8.sh exists in the claude-dev working tree from 2026-11-01. It predates this task and was not touched.
